records.title: RAILWAY PROJECTS IN RAJASTHAN.
details:
a to e: The work of doubling between Ajmer and Chanderiya section (178.28 Km) has been sanctioned at cost of Rs.1634.79 crore. The project has been declared as special railway project. Land acquisition has been taken up.
The work of Bypass line at Marwar (3.9 Km) has been sanctioned at cost of Rs.71.21 crore and the project has been declared as special railway project. Land acquisition has been taken up.
